title: Countdown Timer
h1: Countdown Timer — Count Down to Any Date or Duration
seoTitle: Free Countdown Timer — Online Timer and Date Countdown
description: Create a countdown to a specific date or set a simple duration timer. See days, hours, minutes and seconds. Runs privately in your browser.
intro: Pick a target date or enter hours and minutes for a short timer. The display updates every second.
blurb: Live countdown to a date or for a set duration.
howItWorks: Choose date mode and pick a future date, or duration mode and set hours and minutes.
Press Start to begin the countdown.
The display shows remaining time and updates every second until it reaches zero.
examples: Count down to a product launch or birthday.
Set a 25-minute focus timer (pair with Pomodoro ideas).
Use for cooking, presentations or study sessions.

faq.q: Does the timer keep running if I leave the page?
faq.a: No. It runs only while the tab is open because it is a client-side tool.

faq.q: Is any data sent to a server?
faq.a: No. The timer is calculated entirely in your browser.
Currently hours and minutes. You can approximate short timers with minutes.
